text:
Ashley M: Quick visual ask: need a micro-storyboard pack + routing guide for the 'Inference Economics' webinar. 3 hero tiles (static), 6 carousel cards, 1 one-pager. Need brand-safe checks + inbound lead routing snippet. Deadline: EOD Thurs. @Leo P can you confirm messaging variants?

Leo P: On it. can we split hero tiles: Latency, Cost, Reliability? also need 16:9 and 1:1 sizes. I'll post copy.

Sarah G: Prefer to avoid heavy diagrams on hero. We can do sparkline + short stat. For carousel, give visual hierarchy: title, stat, 1-line takeaway. Quick mock by Wed.

Rahul K: Routing: inbound from webinar should go to 'webinar-bench' campaign in SFDC, tag=webinar_inference. Also lead score rules: >50 -> SDR. I'll write the snippet for ops.

design-ops-bot: Reminder: brand tokens v2 required. See https://redwood/docs/brand/visuals. Also approved font file attached.

Evelyn T: FYI legal needs the benchmark claims backed — share sources for stats. Ashley, can you add source links?

Ashley M: copy v1 pasted: 'Redwood Inference reduces per-token cost by up to 4x vs naive endpoints.' sources: internal perf report 2026-Q1 (link), open model benchmarks (link). @Sarah G can you avoid 'up to' phrasing? legal flag.

Sarah G: Yep let's change to 'model-dependent improvements observed up to 4x in our bench tests' — safer. Will update mock.

Leo P: Copy options: short headline variants: 1) 'Inference that scales, not your bill' 2) 'Lower cost, predictable latency' 3) 'Serve large models efficiently' pick 1-2. Prefer 1 and 2.

Ashley M: Picking 1 + 2. Deliverables checklist:
- 3 hero tiles (16:9, 1:1)
- 6 carousel cards (1080x1080)
- 1 one-pager PDF (A4 + US Letter)
- 1 routing snippet for ops (CSV)
- Brand compliance checklist
Assign: Sarah (visuals), Leo (copy), Rahul (routing), Evelyn (legal).

design-ops-bot: Uploaded tokenized color swatches to #design-assets. /attach: brand_tokens_v2.sketch

Rahul K: Also recommend embedding a short sign-up CTA in slide 3 linking to /signup?utm=webinar

Evelyn T: Legal ok with phrasing Sarah proposed. Need final source doc before publish.

Ashley M: cool. I'll collect assets and post final mock in this thread by Wed 3pm. Thanks team :rocket:
